# FlexibleNeuromorphicSubstrate

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A mechanically bendable or stretchable substrate (e.g., polymer or paper) that supports organic transistor arrays for wearable or conformable neuromorphic systems. Enables novel form factors for distributed sensing and computing, allowing TCC-inspired architectures to be deployed in non-planar, energy-constrained environments.
